best_model_selection: max macro-F1 under 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold among logreg and random_forest; same CV used for selection and performance estimation (not nested CV)
genus_prior_interpretation: Ungrouped genus-prior lift indicates random-split genus leakage / within-genus information leakage, not proof that biological relatedness predicts colour outside that leakage.
importance_method: permutation; mean decrease in held-out macro-F1 within each genus-grouped fold of the selected model; aggregated across folds
importance_aggregation: mean and sd of per-fold mean drops
